svg.title: D · What each run must show

g.text: D · What each run must show
Illustrative results, not a built test dashboard
Match image digest, file hashes, migration history, scenario and saved facts. Missing or changed input fails, without silently rebuilding it.
No access to real AEAT, Cloud, payments, printers or the LAN. Keep node identity and old boot protections; stop only the test’s own processes.
Separate input, start, migration and data-comparison failures. Keep bounded logs and a field-level difference. A skip is not a pass.
Keep issued F2 records, pending outbox, staff history and disabled-module data. A recipient on an unpaid order is not an issued F1 invoice; required
issued-F1 coverage stays open if the old image cannot create it.
Illustrative review board. No implementation is approved.
